title: Free Trials
seo: Free trial setup for SaaS subscriptions
meta: Free trials with or without a card, reminder emails and a smooth switch to a paid plan. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Free trials that turn into paid plans
overview: We set up a free trial that fits how your customers buy. You choose how long it lasts and whether a card is needed up front. We build the trial start, show how many days remain, send reminder emails before it ends and move people onto a paid plan at the right moment. If a trial ends without payment, the account drops to a limited state instead of vanishing.

Days left shown in the app

pkgs.blurb: A card-on-file or no-card trial with reminder emails.

faq: Should I ask for a card at the start?
Both work. A no-card trial often brings in more sign-ups, while a card trial often converts a higher share to paid. We explain each, and you choose. We do not promise results.
What happens to a customer's data when a trial ends?
We keep it, and the account moves to a limited or read-only state, based on your choice. If they upgrade later, everything is still there.
Can you stop people from starting repeat trials?
We can add sensible checks, such as one trial per email and per company. Nobody can block every repeat sign-up, but these checks reduce it without annoying genuine users.
Do I need a payment provider set up already?
For a card trial, yes, such as Stripe. For a no-card trial it is not required at first. If you need to set one up, our payment provider setup service covers it.
